newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian March industrial output falls 3.6 percent.
newsitem.headline: Italian March industrial output falls 3.6 percent.

text.p: National Statistics Institute ISTAT gave the following provisional figures for industrial production, year-on-year, in March.
Note: (The industrial production index was rebased in January 1994 on 1990 levels, replacing a 1985-based index.)
-- Istat said average daily output, non seasonally adjusted but workday adjusted, rose 0.3 percent year-on-year in March after a rise of 0.8 percent in February.
-- Production of consumer goods, on an unadjusted basis, fell 1.1 percent year-on-year in March. Investment goods dropped 8.9 percent and intermediate goods fell 3.3 percent.

-- On a adjusted basis, production of leather goods fell 3.3 percent year-on-year, textile and clothing fell 2.2 percent, non-metal minerals fell 3.2 percent, metals fell 5.1 percent, machinery fell 6.3 and transport rose 1.2. Paper products rose 2.4 percent and refineries and carbon coke rose 2.4 percent.
"The March data is positive," ISTAT chief economist Enrico Giovannini told reporters
